resources.string: This document could not be read. It may be damaged or the storage may be unavailable. Retry or open it in another app.
This is an older Word file (.doc) or a password-protected document. The preview reads unprotected .docx files only; open it in another app.
This file is not a Word .docx package, so it cannot be previewed here. Open it in another app.
This document is larger or more complex than the preview reads. Open it in another app to see all of it.
Read-only text preview. Paragraphs, basic emphasis and list markers are shown; table cells are read in order. Images, drawings, page layout, headers, footers and exact numbering need an Office app.
